channel.title: node-opcua
channel.description: The open-source OPC UA stack for Node.js. News, tutorials, and updates.

item.title: v2.174.0: full OPC UA Role-Based Security ships in open source
item.description: NodeOPCUA v2.174.0 ships the complete OPC 10000-18 Role-Based Security and User Management model in the MIT-licensed core. One-call setup, encrypted persistence, admin over OPC UA itself.

item.title: Boosting OPCUA Communication with @sterfive/opcua-optimized-client
item.description: How the @sterfive/opcua-optimized-client module automatically handles server limitations by intelligently merging and splitting transactions for optimal OPC UA performance.

item.title: Enhancing Industrial Automation with OPC UA Modeling and Object-Oriented Process Modeling
item.description: How OPC UA modeling and object-oriented process modeling provide a more intuitive, scalable alternative to traditional PLC tag naming conventions.

item.title: Where Industry-Grade Meets 'Always Beta' Through Open-Source
item.description: How Sterfive combines industry-grade reliability with open-source community testing under a perpetual beta development model.

item.title: Ride the Open-Source Wave with NodeOPCUA
item.description: A call to action for the node-opcua community to support and sustain the project through sponsorship and engagement.

item.title: NodeOPCUA: When Seamless Operation Sparks a Sustainable Partnership
item.description: Discusses how NodeOPCUA's commitment to high-quality, low-maintenance software fosters sustainable partnerships, and encourages community support for continued development.

item.title: Node-OPCUA goes PubSub - Episode 1
item.description: Demonstrates how to extend a Node-OPCUA server with PubSub support, streaming sensor values to an MQTT broker using standardized OPC-UA JSON payloads.

item.title: Node-OPCUA goes typescript
item.description: Announcing Node-OPCUA 2.0.0 with improved TypeScript support, making it easier to create OPC-UA server and client applications with full IDE intellisense.

item.title: Node-Opcua 0.2.0 will make it easier than ever to write OPC-UA Client code
item.description: Demonstrates how Node-OPCUA 0.2.0 leverages ES2017 async/await to simplify writing OPC-UA client code, with comparisons to Promise and callback styles.

item.title: Node-OPCUA 0.0.50 has been released
item.description: Release notes for Node-OPCUA 0.0.50, introducing enhancements like TwoStateDiscreteType, MultiStateDiscreteType, Matrix Variants, and several breaking API changes.

item.title: Node-Opcua 0.0.50 : ObjectType and Object instantiation
item.description: A tutorial covering how to create ObjectTypes, enrich them with components and properties, and instantiate objects from them in Node-OPCUA 0.0.50.

item.title: a weather station server in Node-OPCUA
item.description: A tutorial on building a virtual weather station OPC-UA server using Node.js, fetching real-time weather data from a REST API and exposing it via OPC-UA variables.

item.title: weather station in node-opcua
item.description: An older tutorial on creating an OPC-UA virtual weather station server using Node.js and the worldweatheronline REST API.
